identificationModule.briefTitle: Safety & Efficacy Study of AT-101 in Combination w/ Rituximab in Previously Untreated Grade I-II Follicular Non-Hodgkin's Lymphoma
identificationModule.officialTitle: An Open-label, Multicenter, Phase II Study of AT-101 in Combination With Rituximab in Patients With Untreated, Grade I-II, Follicular Non-Hodgkin's Lymphoma

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a phase II clinical trial in patients who have not received systemic treatment for follicular non-Hodgkin's lymphoma. The study combines rituximab, an approved drug for this disease, with AT-101, an experimental drug. The hypothesis is that by adding AT-101 to the rituximab regimen, improvement to patients' response to the treatment will be observed verses rituximab alone.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: Further Study Details provided by Ascenta.

interventions.name: AT-101
interventions.description: AT-101 30 mg orally for 21 of 56 days, every cycle. Cycle = 56 days; Max of 5 cycles.

interventions.name: Rituximab
interventions.description: Rituximab 375mg/m2 IV once per week for four weeks during 1st cycle, 375mg/m2 IV once per cycle for cycles 2-5. Cycle = 56 days; Max of 5 cycles.

primaryOutcomes.measure: complete or partial remission of disease

secondaryOutcomes.measure: duration of complete or partial remission of disease
